import sys
import pathlib

# Add the directory of the current file to sys.path
sys.path.append(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

from bst import BinarySearchTree


def test_binary_search_tree():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()

    # Test empty tree
    assert bst.search(10) == False, "Failed on empty tree search"
    assert bst.inorder() == [], "Failed on empty tree inorder"

    # Test inserting elements
    bst.insert(10)
    bst.insert(5)
    bst.insert(15)
    bst.insert(10)  # Duplicate, should be ignored

    # Test search
    assert bst.search(10) == True, "Failed to find 10"
    assert bst.search(5) == True, "Failed to find 5"
    assert bst.search(15) == True, "Failed to find 15"
    assert bst.search(20) == False, "Found nonexistent value 20"

    # Test inorder traversal
    assert bst.inorder() == [5, 10, 15], "Inorder traversal failed"

    # Test inserting negative values
    bst.insert(-10)
    bst.insert(-5)
    assert bst.inorder() == [-10, -5, 5, 10, 15], "Inorder traversal failed after inserting negatives"

    # Test repeated traversal
    assert bst.inorder() == [-10, -5, 5, 10, 15], "Repeated traversal failed"

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_binary_search_tree()

qa_reports.test_code:
import pytest
from bst import BinarySearchTree


def test_insert_adds_integer():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    assert bst.insert(10) is True
    assert bst.inorder() == [10]


def test_insert_ignores_duplicates():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(10)
    assert bst.insert(10) is False
    assert bst.inorder() == [10]


def test_insert_allows_negative_values():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    assert bst.insert(-5) is True
    assert bst.insert(-10) is True
    assert bst.inorder() == [-10, -5]


def test_insert_ignores_none():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    assert bst.insert(None) is False
    assert bst.inorder() == []


def test_search_returns_true_for_present_value():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(10)
    assert bst.search(10) is True


def test_search_returns_false_for_missing_value():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(10)
    assert bst.search(5) is False


def test_search_returns_false_for_none():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    assert bst.search(None) is False


def test_inorder_returns_empty_list_for_empty_tree():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    assert bst.inorder() == []


def test_inorder_returns_sorted_list():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(10)
    bst.insert(5)
    bst.insert(15)
    assert bst.inorder() == [5, 10, 15]


def test_inorder_with_negative_values():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(-5)
    bst.insert(-10)
    bst.insert(0)
    assert bst.inorder() == [-10, -5, 0]


def test_inorder_with_duplicates():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(10)
    bst.insert(5)
    bst.insert(10)  # Duplicate
    assert bst.inorder() == [5, 10]


def test_repeated_traversal():
    bst = BinarySearchTree()
    bst.insert(10)
    bst.insert(5)
    bst.insert(15)
    assert bst.inorder() == [5, 10, 15]
    assert bst.inorder() == [5, 10, 15]  # Repeated traversal
